stories.title: This closely-watched guru just sold everything
stories.summary: Panmure Liberum strategist and widely-followed stock-market commentator Joachim Klement has effectively had his personal retirement portfolio 100% invested in stocks for many years.
stories.zh_title: 這位備受關注的大師剛剛賣掉了所有東西
stories.zh_summary: Panmure Liberum 策略師、廣受關注的股市評論員 Joachim Klement 多年來實際上將其個人退休投資組合 100% 投資於股票。

stories.summary: This summer, OpenAI paused its largest planned frontier training run after its AI agents accidentally hacked Hugging Face and early evidence suggested that its next model could independently find and exploit security flaws. stories.zh_title: 還記得尖端人工智慧暫停嗎？晶片公司也不記得
stories.zh_summary: 今年夏天，在 OpenAI 的 AI 代理程式意外入侵 Hugging Face，且早期證據顯示其下一代模型可能能夠獨立發現並利用安全漏洞後，OpenAI 暫停了其計劃中規模最大的前沿訓練作業。9 月，Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 呼籲放緩

stories.title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
stories.summary: New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago schools are considering Google alternatives after the company said it will disable Search for schools that opt out of its AI features, according to The New York Times. Starting next year, schools will not have the option to disable Gemini-powered features without also disabling Search. Chris Phillips, Google's vice […]
stories.zh_title: 美國最大的學區正考慮放棄使用 Google 搜尋
stories.zh_summary: 根據《紐約時報》報導，在 Google 表示將對選擇停用其 AI 功能的學校停用搜尋功能後，紐約、洛杉磯和芝加哥的學校正在考慮使用 Google 的替代方案。從明年開始，學校將無法在沒有……的情況下選擇停用由 Gemini 提供支援的功能。

stories.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
stories.summary: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.
stories.zh_title: 薩提亞·納德拉 (Satya Nadella) 預測，AI 代理將重塑網路經濟
stories.zh_summary: 微軟執行長表示，AI 代理程式可能會顛覆以廣告為主的商業模式，迫使亞馬遜等公司重新思考如何競爭客戶。

stories.title: The stock market is being rocked by the biggest shake-up in a generation as tech falls behind
stories.summary: Tech stocks are looking cheap, while defensive sectors like consumer staples are screening as expensive.
stories.zh_title: 隨著科技股表現落後，股市正經歷一代人以來最大的震盪。
stories.zh_summary: 科技股看起來便宜，而必需消費品等防禦性類股則顯得昂貴。

stories.title: How Toyota is betting on a future beyond cars
stories.summary: Toyota is looking beyond the automotive industry as it places bigger bets on robotics, physical AI, energy, aerospace, and other emerging technologies. Through its venture arm, Woven Capital, the automaker is investing in startups that could help shape what the company looks like decades from now. But as startup valuations climb and competition for promising […]
stories.zh_title: 豐田如何押注汽車以外的未來
stories.zh_summary: 豐田正將目光投向汽車產業之外，對機器人、實體人工智慧、能源、航空航太及其他新興技術下注更多。透過其創投部門 Woven Capital，這家汽車製造商正在投資一些新創公司，這些公司可能會幫助塑造該公司在未來幾十年後的面貌。B

stories.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
stories.summary: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
stories.zh_title: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 表示：「很難想像沒有 Jensen 的 AI 產業。」
stories.zh_summary: Nvidia 創辦人暨前執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 上週因多起醜聞而辭職，其中包括與一名疑似中國間諜的婚外情。

stories.title: Anthropic IPO raises over $81 billion in largest offering on record, topping SpaceX
stories.summary: Anthropic stock is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT on Thursday.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 的 IPO 募資超過 810 億美元，創下史上最大規模的公開發行紀錄，超越 SpaceX。
stories.zh_summary: Anthropic 的股票將於週四在納斯達克 (Nasdaq) 上市交易，股票代號為 ANT。

stories.title: Palo Alto Networks’ stock gets a fresh AI-fueled boost from earnings
stories.summary: The company boosts its outlook in the face of the “current threat environment and demand we see ahead of us.”
stories.zh_title: Palo Alto Networks 的股價因財報而獲得 AI 推動的新助力
stories.zh_summary: 面對「當前的威脅環境和我們預見的未來需求」，公司提升了其前景展望。

stories.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
stories.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
stories.zh_title: 微軟執行長薩提亞·納德拉 (Satya Nadella) 解釋他為何要求 6 萬名員工離職
stories.zh_summary: 微軟執行長薩提亞·納德拉 (Satya Nadella) 解釋了他為何在 10 月向 6 萬名員工提供優退方案，實際上是敦促他們自願離職，而非透過另一波大規模裁員來縮減員工人數。簡短的答案是人工智慧，但並非以您可能預期的那種方式。

stories.title: Palo Alto inks $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute, shares pop 7% on earnings
stories.summary: Palo Alto Networks has been steadily acquiring companies to capitalize on demand for cyber tools to fight AI.
stories.zh_title: Palo Alto 以 45 億美元的價格收購 AI 新創公司 Applied Compute，股價因財報表現上漲 7%
stories.zh_summary: Palo Alto Networks 一直在穩步收購公司，以利用對抗人工智慧的網路工具需求。

stories.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia has a new problem — and it has nothing to do with earnings
stories.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer warned that Anthropic's highly anticipated IPO presents another headwind for Nvidia.
stories.zh_title: 吉姆·克萊默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，輝達 (Nvidia) 面臨一個新問題，但與獲利無關。
stories.zh_summary: CNBC 的 Jim Cramer 警告，Anthropic 備受期待的 IPO 對 Nvidia 構成另一項不利因素。

stories.title: What the ‘death cross’ in small-cap stocks means for the rest of the market
stories.summary: The negative chart pattern confirms weakness in the Russell 2000 and in overall market breadth.
stories.zh_title: 小型股的「死亡交叉」對市場其他部分有何影響
stories.zh_summary: 負面圖表型態證實了羅素 2000 指數與整體市場廣度的疲軟。

stories.title: Has the stock market’s slump hit bottom yet? Here’s what these contrarian indicators say.
stories.summary: Contrarian buy signals typically don’t come until sentiment has dropped further than they have so far
stories.zh_title: 股市的低迷是否已經觸底？以下是這些反指標的看法。
stories.zh_summary: 逆向買入訊號通常要等到市場情緒進一步低落才會出現。

stories.title: One of AI's most notorious 'doomers' stands to make billions in Anthropic's IPO
stories.summary: An Estonian tech billionaire famous for his stance that AI could end humanity is expected to be one of the biggest winners in Anthropic's upcoming IPO.
stories.zh_title: 其中一位最臭名昭著的人工智慧「末日論者」有望在 Anthropic 的 IPO 中賺取數十億美元。
stories.zh_summary: 一位以認為人工智慧可能導致人類滅絕的觀點而聞名的愛沙尼亞科技億萬富翁，預計將成為 Anthropic 即將進行的首次公開發行 (IPO) 中最大的贏家之一。

stories.title: Spend management platform Payhawk announces $280M raise, 2B valuation
stories.summary: Founded in 2018, Payhawk is an enterprise financial management platform that helps companies track and manage expenses and procurement using AI agents.
stories.zh_title: 支出管理平台 Payhawk 宣布籌資 2.8 億美元，估值達 20 億美元
stories.zh_summary: Payhawk 成立於 2018 年，是一家企業財務管理平台，透過 AI 代理人協助公司追蹤與管理支出及採購。

stories.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed US robotics companies the data they need
stories.summary: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups such as Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.
stories.zh_title: 印度的 Humyn Labs 籌集了 4,700 萬美元，為美國的機器人公司提供所需的資料
stories.zh_summary: Humyn Labs 成立於 2 月，與 Mecka AI 和 XDOF 等新創公司競爭，其約 90% 的營收來自美國。

stories.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
stories.summary: In a lab near Newark Airport in New Jersey, a team of around 30 experienced human sniffers are slowly working their way through every odor on Earth. Their careful notes—“nutty,” “peachy,” “marine”—are cross-referenced with a chemical analysis to create a rich set of training data for what AI startup Osmo calls the world’s first foundation…
stories.zh_title: 這家嗅覺新創公司表示，其 AI 鼻子與人類鼻子一樣靈敏。
stories.zh_summary: 在新澤西州紐華克機場附近的一個實驗室裡，一支由約 30 名經驗豐富的人類嗅探員組成的團隊正在緩慢地辨識地球上的每種氣味。他們仔細記錄的筆記——「堅果味」、「蜜桃味」、「海洋味」——與化學分析進行交叉比對，為 AI 新創公司建立了一套豐富的訓練資料。
